purpose: external validation of the e-ATS versus GLR authorization contrast on every geometry row omitted from the first GLR comparison

known_before_freeze.glr_outcomes: known only for K=4 and K=32
known_before_freeze.selection_rule: take the complete complement of the previously evaluated K rows; no mechanism, budget, environment, or result-based subdivision is omitted

selection.full_table_rows: all four B values and all ten mechanisms for K=8, K=16, and K=64
selection.confirmatory_unit: all 9,828 nonstationary environment-tape groups pooled with equal group weight

calibration.population: registered stationary random environments in the untouched geometries
calibration.detector_trace: strict OTS action and reward trajectory
calibration.glr_statistic: maximum over time, arms, and the canonical geometric candidate grid of the two-segment Bernoulli log generalized likelihood ratio against one pooled Bernoulli mean
calibration.threshold_rule: within each K_B geometry choose an interior cutoff giving exactly the canonical e-process stationary crossing count; when that count is zero use nextafter(maximum_calibration_score,+infinity)
calibration.known_limitation: 273 trajectories per geometry cannot precisely estimate the very small e-process crossing probability; exact calibration-count matching is not false-alarm-rate equivalence

policies.strict_ots: archived strict OTS outcome from the canonical evaluation
policies.always_open_ramp: archived canonical no-C^E full-budget normalized-ramp outcome
policies.glr_e_ats: new run replacing only the historical authorization latch with the calibrated GLR latch

fairness_constraints: GLR threshold calibration uses stationary outcomes only
GLR and e-process use the same geometric candidate splits
GLR changes only the authorization event; ramp, latch persistence, short discount, reliability, score, tie rule, and controller constants remain fixed
all comparisons are paired on identical means and potential rewards
no untouched-row GLR policy outcome is opened before this protocol is frozen

inference.primary_estimand: mean GLR-e-ATS normalized dynamic pseudo-regret minus canonical e-ATS normalized dynamic pseudo-regret over all 9,828 nonstationary groups
inference.success_rule_for_empirical_e_ats_advanta: the lower endpoint of the predeclared two-sided paired stratified-bootstrap 95 percent interval is greater than zero
inference.failure_rule: zero or a negative value in that interval means this study does not establish an empirical e-ATS regret advantage
inference.subgroup_results: descriptive only and cannot rescue a failed pooled primary result
inference.combination_with_K4_K32: descriptive complete-grid synthesis only because those GLR outcomes were already known
